text:
Marco: Morning — planning a small-batch release for routing + batching tweaks. aiming for 11:30 PT slot. low-risk but want a quick smoke and rollback ready.
Priya: I can own smoke if it stays under 30m. can we limit to the two routes only?
Marco: yes, only /v1/generate and /v1/batch-embed. config change + one model pin.
Zoe: 11:30 PT works for me. I'll watch latency dashboards and traces.
Carlos: putting the rollout in the release train board now. @Marco which commit/tag?
Marco: tag is release/routing-batch-2026-03-17. diff is small.
Alice: thumbs for smoke. I'll run the smoke checklist and confirm token cost looks normal.
Dana: FYI I'll be in the hotseat for rollback steps. keep the rollback button and rollback tag handy.
Ben: quick note — can we gate on canary success for 5m before full flip?
Marco: yes. canary = 5% traffic for 5m then 25% if ok, then full after another 10m.
Priya: smoke checklist (condensed):
```
- deploy tag: release/routing-batch-2026-03-17
- routes: /v1/generate, /v1/batch-embed
- canary: 5% -> 25% -> full
- smoke tests: 200 reqs gen, 100 embed avg latency < 120ms
- rollback: deployctl rollback --to=release/previous
- metrics: 1m token cost, 99th latency, error rate
```
Carlos: adding the canary windows and watchers in the board. tagging Dana and Zoe.
Alice: running smoke locally now -> posting quick results in 15m.
DeployBot: Scheduled deployment 11:30 PT for release/routing-batch-2026-03-17. Canary policy: [5m @5% -> 10m @25%]. Watchers: Zoe, Dana, Priya, Alice.
Zoe: dashboards preloaded. will alert on +10% latency or +0.5% error rate.
Dana: ready for rollback command. @Marco drop the rollback snippet in thread when you trigger.
Marco: will do. if canary fails we rollback to release/2026-03-10.
Priya: ack. I'll start smoke at 11:35 PT once canary reaches 5%.
Alice: smoke pass locally. no obvious regressions. will confirm after canary.
Ben: noted one quick QA: check KV cache behavior for long context—I can run 50 long-context requests during canary.
Marco: thanks Ben — assign those to your user agent and label them "long-context-canary".
Carlos: all set on the release board. tagging stakeholders in the meeting note.
Marco: cool. final checklist: deploy window 11:30 PT, canary watchers active, rollback ready. ping here when flipped. :rocket:
Priya: will post canary metrics after 5m.
DeployBot: Deployment started (11:30 PT) — canary stage initiated at 5% traffic.
Zoe: canary metrics steady at 3m. error rate 0.03%, latency +2% — holding for 5m.
Priya: 5m check: gen success 98.7%, embed latency avg 110ms — good to move to 25%.
DeployBot: Canary advanced to 25% traffic.
Alice: running extended smoke now. nothing alarming after 3m.
Dana: standing by for rollback but all green from my side.
Marco: advancing to full after 10m unless objections.
Ben: go ahead. my long-context tests look fine.
DeployBot: Deployment completed — full traffic. tag release/routing-batch-2026-03-17 live.
Zoe: final checks: latency within 4% of baseline, error rate stable.
Marco: thanks everyone. closing the slot. please file any followups in the release notes thread. :white_check_mark:
